boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Art Center College of Design
boards.description: ArtCenter students often work late in the studios, making these Pasadena late-night spots essential for refueling during intensive design projects.

cards.title: The Famous Breakfast Burrito Run
cards.subtitle: 640 S Arroyo Pkwy, Pasadena, CA 91105
cards.notes: Order the signature breakfast burrito at this roadside stand. It is a staple for students working late at the nearby South Campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A historic Pasadena burger stand famous for its massive breakfast burritos served all day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Boy on Arroyo Parkway is open daily from 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily; outdoor seating available.

cards.title: Late-Night Street Tacos
cards.subtitle: 510 S Fair Oaks Ave, Pasadena, CA 91105
cards.notes: Visit this historic taco truck for authentic street tacos. It is a popular late-night destination for students seeking quick, affordable fuel.
cards.short_summary: A pioneering Pasadena taco truck known for its authentic Mexico City-style street tacos and late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Los California Tacos is a late-night spot known for its taco truck style service near Fair Oaks and California Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Typically open late; cash only; no indoor seating.

cards.title: Old Pasadena Taco Stop
cards.subtitle: 45 N Fair Oaks Ave, Pasadena, CA 91103
cards.notes: Stop by for sopes or tacos with their signature red salsa. This Old Pasadena location serves as a reliable late-night anchor for the student community.
cards.short_summary: A legendary Los Angeles Mexican fast-food chain location in the heart of Old Pasadena.
cards.evidence_claim: King Taco in Pasadena is located in Old Pasadena and is open late each night.
cards.access_notes: Open late daily; counter service with indoor seating.

cards.title: Gourmet Dogs and Sliders
cards.subtitle: 93 E Green St, Pasadena, CA 91105
cards.notes: Try a gourmet hot dog on King's Hawaiian rolls. The late-night happy hour makes it a frequent choice for students finishing evening studio sessions.
cards.short_summary: A casual spot in Old Pasadena specializing in hormone-free hot dogs, sausages, and burgers.
cards.evidence_claim: Dog Haus Biergarten Pasadena is open until 12:00 AM for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: Dog Haus Biergarten Pasadena Green St
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight; features outdoor seating and a late-night happy hour.

cards.title: World Famous Pastrami Dips
cards.subtitle: 491 N Lake Ave, Pasadena, CA 91101
cards.notes: Order the pastrami dip and chili cheese fries for a heavy late-night meal. It is a classic Southern California institution frequented by locals and students.
cards.short_summary: A historic SoCal chain famous for its generous portions of pastrami and retro roadside vibe.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hat in Pasadena is open daily from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily; counter service with indoor and outdoor seating.

cards.title: 24-Hour Donut and Coffee Run
cards.subtitle: 439 E Orange Grove Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91104
cards.notes: Grab a dozen donuts or a bagel sandwich at any hour. This 24-hour spot is the ultimate fallback for all-night design marathons.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour donut shop serving fresh pastries, coffee, and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Winchell's Donut House on Orange Grove Blvd is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Fresh Donuts & Coffee at 439 E Orange Grove Blvd, in Pasadena
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily; convenient for late-night or early-morning study breaks.

cards.title: The California Late-Night Classic
cards.subtitle: 2114 E Foothill Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91107
cards.notes: Head to the drive-thru for a Double-Double. It is the quintessential late-night destination for students across Southern California.
cards.short_summary: The iconic California burger chain known for its fresh ingredients and simple menu.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out Burger in Pasadena is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pasadena, CA, 2114 E. Foothill Blvd.. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and patio seating available until 1:00 AM or later.

cards.title: Quality Grub and Pastrami
cards.subtitle: 3838 E Colorado Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91107
cards.notes: Visit for a hefty pastrami sandwich or a breakfast burrito. This family-owned spot has been a Pasadena favorite for over 70 years.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Pasadena eatery serving a wide variety of American and Mexican-inspired comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Original Tops is open Monday-Thursday until 10:00 PM and Friday-Saturday until 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Home - The Original Tops - American Restaurant in Pasadena, CA
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM; features indoor booth seating.

cards.title: Authentic Tonkotsu Ramen
cards.subtitle: 16 N Fair Oaks Ave, Pasadena, CA 91103
cards.notes: Warm up with a bowl of Koku Tonkotsu ramen. The rich broth is perfect for late-night energy during the cooler Pasadena evenings.
cards.short_summary: A popular Japanese ramen chain's first U.S. location, specializing in rich pork-based broth.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramen Tatsunoya in Old Pasadena is a popular late-night dining option known for its authentic craftsmanship.
cards.source_title: Ramen Tatsunoya | Enjoy Authentic Ramen Today
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; often has a line but moves quickly.

cards.title: Baja-Style Seafood Tacos
cards.subtitle: 2234 N Lincoln Ave, Altadena, CA 91001
cards.notes: Try the fish tacos or shrimp burritos at this Altadena spot. It offers a fresh alternative to the typical late-night burger run.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite specializing in authentic Baja-style seafood tacos and ceviche.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos Ensenada in Altadena is open until 10:00 PM Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Tacos Ensenada Seafood (Altadena) | Altadena, CA 91001 | Menu | Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM most nights; counter service with some outdoor seating.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional hubs and creative retreats where ArtCenter students actually spend their time, from specialized labs to quiet hillside pavilions.

cards.title: Fogg Library Stacks
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Utilize the long tables for deep research or browse the extensive zine collection. It serves as a quiet retreat from the high-energy studio environments.
cards.short_summary: The flagship library at the Hillside Campus offering quiet study areas and a massive collection of art and design resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fogg Library is described as the heart of ArtCenter, featuring aisles of books and long tables for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. during the term.

cards.title: Sinclaire Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Head to this open-air pavilion to socialize or study away from the main building. It features amphitheater seating and a small kitchen for student use.
cards.short_summary: An inviting, open-air student space designed for relaxation and interdisciplinary interaction outside the Ellwood Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sinclaire Pavilion provides students a place to gather, socialize, study, and exchange ideas with flexible gallery space and a kitchen.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students for leisure and educational needs; formal events require scheduling.

cards.title: Kohl Commons
cards.subtitle: South Campus 1111 Building
cards.notes: Gather at this central dining hub to eat and collaborate. The space is filled with natural light and often displays student artwork on the walls.
cards.short_summary: The main social and dining epicenter for South Campus, located on the ground floor of the 1111 Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Kohl Commons is the main dining hub for South Campus facilities, serving as a social hub for students from various disciplines.
cards.access_notes: Dining hours are typically 7:30 am to 5:00 pm on weekdays.

cards.title: HMCT 950 Gallery
cards.subtitle: South Campus 950 Building
cards.notes: Visit this gallery to see rotating exhibitions focused on typography and visual communication. It is located at the entrance of the wind tunnel building.
cards.short_summary: A specialized gallery space showcasing notable work in typography and letterform design within the historic wind tunnel building.
cards.evidence_claim: The 950 Gallery showcases notable work in typography and serves as an educational tool for students and the public.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. except during winter break.

cards.title: Archetype Press
cards.subtitle: South Campus 950 Building
cards.notes: Experience traditional letterpress printing in this 'working museum.' It houses over 2,500 cases of metal and wood type for student use.
cards.short_summary: The largest educational letterpress studio in the country, where students practice hand-setting type and manual printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Archetype Press offers students the opportunity to practice setting type and printing by hand with a massive collection of foundry type.
cards.access_notes: Available for student use and workshops; check specific lab hours.

cards.title: Hillside Student Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus Entrance
cards.notes: Check out the rotating selection of exemplary student projects curated from every department. The work is updated three times per year.
cards.short_summary: A front-and-center exhibition space at the Hillside Campus entrance dedicated to showcasing current student-produced art and design.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Gallery at Hillside features a selection of student work curated from each undergraduate department every term.
cards.access_notes: Located at the entrance of the Hillside Campus; accessible during campus hours.

cards.title: Color, Materials and Trends Exploration Laboratory
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Explore material samples from over 150 manufacturers. This lab is a vital resource for students researching lighting, sustainability, and market trends.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated research lab for color, materials, and trends, hosting workshops and intensive 'Design Storms.'
cards.evidence_claim: CMTEL hosts classes and workshops with an emphasis on color, materials, and technology, featuring a collection of manufacturer samples.
cards.access_notes: Open for classes, workshops, and student research during lab hours.

cards.title: 870 Building Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: South Campus 870 Building
cards.notes: Use these high-end labs to complete digital assignments if you don't have the required tech. They are located on the second level of the 870 building.
cards.short_summary: Specialized computing facilities at the South Campus 870 Building designed to support student coursework and digital production.
cards.evidence_claim: The 870 Building map identifies computer labs on Level 2, and the handbook notes they are available for students to complete assignments.
cards.access_notes: Available to students with valid ID; specific lab policies apply.

cards.title: Mullin Center Viewing Deck
cards.subtitle: South Campus 950 Building
cards.notes: Observe the fabrication studio and vehicle architecture lab from this mezzanine-level deck. It offers a unique perspective on the design process.
cards.short_summary: A mezzanine-level viewing area within the Mullin Transportation Design Center that overlooks active fabrication and studio spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mullin Center includes a viewing deck on the mezzanine level that hovers above a fabrication studio and vehicle architecture lab.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students within the 950 Building during campus hours.

cards.title: Hutto-Patterson Exhibition Hall
cards.subtitle: South Campus 870 Building
cards.notes: Explore this exhibition space curated by the Fine Art and Illustration departments. It's a key spot for seeing specialized student and faculty work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated exhibition hall at the South Campus 870 Building featuring curated displays from specific academic departments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hutto-Patterson Exhibition Hall is curated by the Fine Art and Illustration Departments and is located in the 870 Building.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 1 of the 870 Building; open during campus hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore free galleries, scenic outdoor spaces, and creative hubs across ArtCenter's Hillside and South campuses in Pasadena.

cards.title: View Art-Science Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Visit this 4,600-square-foot gallery to see rotating exhibitions at the intersection of art and science. Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery at the Hillside Campus focusing on the intersection of art, science, and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to ArtCenter Exhibitions' physical and online galleries and programs is always free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12 p.m. to 5 p.m. Reservations are recommended.

cards.title: Explore Multidisciplinary Art
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Walk through this South Campus gallery featuring solo and group exhibitions ranging from fine art to automotive design. Admission is free.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery at the South Campus showcasing a variety of media including transportation design.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to ArtCenter Exhibitions' physical and online galleries and programs is always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Peter and Merle Mullin Gallery | Exhibitions - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Check in with security at the 1111 S. Arroyo Parkway building entrance.

cards.title: See Typographic Design
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Visit the Hoffmitz Milken Center for Typography to see exhibitions dedicated to letterform design and visual communication. Admission is free.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery at the South Campus dedicated to the study and exhibition of typography.
cards.evidence_claim: HMCT Gallery. Open daily 8am–7pm (except holidays). Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Info - Hoffmitz Milken Center for Typography
cards.access_notes: Open daily 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. except on holidays.

cards.title: Browse Student Projects
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Located at the Hillside Campus entrance, this gallery showcases exemplary student work from all majors. It is free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A public gallery at the Hillside Campus entrance featuring a rotating selection of student work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Gallery, located at the entrance of Hillside campus, offers a sneak peek at the projects crafted by students from all majors at ArtCenter.
cards.source_title: The Student Gallery at Hillside - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during normal campus business hours.

cards.title: Relax in an Open-Air Space
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Gather or study in this 3,000-square-foot open-air pavilion designed by Hodgetts + Fung. It offers views of the San Gabriel Mountains.
cards.short_summary: An architectural open-air pavilion at the Hillside Campus used for student gathering and informal study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sinclaire Pavilion is an inviting, open-air space for students to get away from the normal hustle and bustle... includes informal gathering spaces.
cards.source_title: Sinclaire Pavilion - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Primarily for student use; formal events must be scheduled through the Center for the Student Experience.

cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Stroll through the sprawling lawn at the Hillside Campus to see various sculptures integrated into the wooded landscape.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor space at the Hillside Campus featuring a collection of sculptures on a large lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Sculpture Garden, a sprawling lawn that contains a [collection of works].
cards.source_title: Facilities - ArtCenter Catalog and Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: Located adjacent to the Sinclaire Pavilion on the Hillside Campus.

cards.title: Browse Design Resources
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Visitors can browse the extensive collection of art and design books, zines, and magazines on-site for free during open hours.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library where visitors can access a vast collection of art and design materials for on-site use.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors are free to browse and use collection materials within the library during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday to Thursday 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Visitors must register with security.

cards.title: Hang Out at Hixon Courtyard
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Relax in this central outdoor courtyard at the South Campus, located near the Graduate Art Galleries and Mullin Transportation Design Center.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor gathering space at ArtCenter's South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Hixon Courtyard [is located at the] South Campus 950 S. Raymond Avenue.
cards.source_title: South Campus - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students and registered visitors at the 950 S. Raymond Ave building.

cards.title: See Letterpress Printing
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Observe one of the largest letterpress facilities in the country. The press functions as a working museum of rare wood and metal type.
cards.short_summary: A unique letterpress studio and living archive at the South Campus where visitors can see traditional printing in action.
cards.evidence_claim: The Press, a “working museum” with over 2,500 cases of foundry metal and wood type, is the largest educational letterpress studio in the country.
cards.source_title: Archetype Press - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Located in the 950 building. Public access is typically available during gallery hours or special events.

cards.title: Gather at Kohl Commons
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Use this communal dining and social space at the South Campus to meet friends or work on projects. No purchase is required to use the seating.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant communal and dining space at the South Campus for students and staff to gather.
cards.evidence_claim: Kohl Commons is the primary dining destination for ArtCenter's South Campus, providing a lively and communal space.
cards.source_title: Terri and Jerry Kohl Commons - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Located in the 1111 S. Arroyo Parkway building.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the most productive environments across ArtCenter's Hillside and South campuses, from modernist library stacks to renovated industrial labs.

cards.title: The Flagship Stacks
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Find a spot at the long tables surrounded by over 100,000 art and design volumes. This quiet zone is ideal for deep research and focused individual work.
cards.short_summary: The primary quiet study destination at the Hillside Campus, featuring extensive art book collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fogg Library provides quiet spaces for students to work independently and includes long tables for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. during the term.

cards.title: The Typographic Lab
cards.subtitle: 950 South Raymond Avenue
cards.notes: Work alongside a massive archive of letterform design. The shared work spaces offer a unique, research-heavy environment for graphic design students.
cards.short_summary: A specialized research center and creative studio dedicated to the study of typography.
cards.evidence_claim: The HMCT includes reference libraries organized across the Center's shared work spaces and a main classroom for workshops.
cards.source_title: Info - Hoffmitz Milken Center for Typography
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of the 950 Building; check for specific workshop hours.

cards.title: The South Campus Hub
cards.subtitle: 1111 South Arroyo Parkway
cards.notes: Utilize the modern, functional furniture in this vibrant dining hall for casual group meetings or laptop work between classes.
cards.short_summary: The main social and dining hub of the South Campus, offering ample seating and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: Kohl Commons contains a combination of modern and functional furniture, providing ample seating options for students to relax and engage.
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays for breakfast and lunch; accessible during building hours for study.

cards.title: The Mountain View Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Take your sketchbook to this 3,000-square-foot pavilion for informal gathering and sweeping views of the San Gabriel Mountains.
cards.short_summary: An indoor-outdoor pavilion designed for informal student interaction and mountain views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sinclaire Pavilion includes informal gathering spaces and serves as an extension of the Sculpture Garden.
cards.access_notes: Tucked into the landscape near the main Hillside building; open for student use.

cards.title: The Hovering Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: 950 South Raymond Avenue
cards.notes: Study in the 'floating' flex space on the mezzanine level, overlooking the fabrication studio in this renovated supersonic wind tunnel.
cards.short_summary: A high-volume industrial space featuring a mezzanine level for research and experimentation.
cards.evidence_claim: The MTDC includes a flex space and viewing deck on the mezzanine level that hovers above a fabrication studio.
cards.access_notes: Located within the 950 Building; accessible to students during campus hours.

cards.title: The Materials Lab
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Explore material samples from over 150 manufacturers while you work. This lab is a vital resource for color and trend research.
cards.short_summary: The Color, Materials and Trends Exploration Laboratory, used for specialized design research.
cards.evidence_claim: CMTEL hosts classes and projects with an emphasis on color, materials, and technology, housing a material sample collection.
cards.access_notes: Appointments may be required for specific material archive access; check with lab staff.

cards.title: The Canyon Overlook
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and head to the outdoor patio for a fresh-air study session with views of the surrounding wooded canyon.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor seating area at the Hillside Café, popular for breaks and informal study.
cards.evidence_claim: Active eating and drinking are permitted at the Hillside Campus outdoor seating and student dining room.
cards.access_notes: Café kitchen open Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–3 p.m.; patio accessible during building hours.

cards.title: The Fine Art Lounge
cards.subtitle: 870 South Raymond Avenue
cards.notes: Located on Level 2, this lounge provides a quiet retreat for Fine Art and Illustration students near their individual studios.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student lounge area within the 870 Building's studio complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The 870 Building floor plan identifies a student lounge on Level 2 near the Fine Art individual studios.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with ID; located on the second floor.

cards.title: The Archives Study Room
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Request access to this specialized space to study rare books and ArtCenter's historical records in a controlled environment.
cards.short_summary: The physical home of ArtCenter's Archives and Special Collections.
cards.evidence_claim: In the Jules Bates Artrouble Center, students and researchers can explore the Archives and Special Collections.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m. at the South Campus location.

cards.title: The Level 3 Nook
cards.subtitle: 1111 South Arroyo Parkway
cards.notes: A convenient spot on the third floor for quick snacks and short study bursts between classes in the 1111 Building.
cards.short_summary: A small self-service market area with seating on the third floor of the 1111 Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1111 Building floor plan lists a Micro-market on Level 3 near the Humanities and Sciences offices.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 3; accessible during building hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Use real streets, blocks, corridors, or micro-districts within the practical orbit of this specific campus. Give exactly one sourced reason for each and do not substitute broad city neighborhoods, isolated businesses, safety claims, or demographic stereotypes.

cards.title: The Innovation Corridor
cards.subtitle: South Raymond Avenue
cards.notes: Walk this industrial-chic stretch to reach the Mullin Transportation Design Center and the Hoffmitz Milken Center for Typography.
cards.short_summary: A primary industrial corridor housing ArtCenter's South Campus facilities and maker spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter's South Campus is located in the heart of downtown Pasadena's Innovation Corridor on South Raymond Avenue.
cards.source_title: South Campus - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Public street access; ArtCenter buildings require student ID for entry.

cards.title: The Gateway to Pasadena
cards.subtitle: South Arroyo Parkway
cards.notes: Visit the 1111 Building at the terminus of the historic Arroyo Seco Parkway, serving as a hub for classrooms and administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A major thoroughfare marking the entrance to Pasadena and housing the 1111 South Campus building.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1111 S. Arroyo Parkway building is located at the terminus of the historic Arroyo Seco Parkway.
cards.source_title: South Campus - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; 1111 Building accessible to students with ID.

cards.title: The Hillside Ascent
cards.subtitle: Lida Street
cards.notes: Drive up this winding residential road to reach the iconic modernist Ellwood Building and the Fogg Library.
cards.short_summary: The primary access road for the Hillside Campus, winding through the San Rafael Hills.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillside Campus is located at 1700 Lida Street in Pasadena.
cards.source_title: Hillside Campus - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Public road; campus parking requires a permit or visitor check-in.

cards.title: Old Pasadena Hub
cards.subtitle: Colorado Boulevard
cards.notes: Explore this historic commercial block for art supplies, dining, and the annual Rose Parade route.
cards.short_summary: The main commercial artery of Old Pasadena, popular for student life and retail.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Pasadena is a historic district featuring retail and dining frequently used by ArtCenter students.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial district; open 24/7.

cards.title: The HEART District
cards.subtitle: South Fair Oaks Avenue
cards.notes: Navigate this corridor connecting South Campus to the Fillmore Metro station and local medical and creative offices.
cards.short_summary: A key north-south street connecting South Campus to transit and the broader city.
cards.evidence_claim: The South Fair Oaks Specific Plan (SFOSP) envisions a creative and innovative mixed-use district serving students and faculty.
cards.source_title: South Fair Oaks - City of Pasadena
cards.access_notes: Public street; pedestrian-friendly improvements are part of the city plan.

cards.title: The Civic Center Block
cards.subtitle: East Holly Street
cards.notes: Walk past Pasadena City Hall and local student-favored apartment complexes like Holly Street Village.
cards.short_summary: A scenic street in the Civic Center area known for its architecture and proximity to student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Holly Street Village is a notable apartment complex near the ArtCenter shuttle route at Memorial Park.
cards.access_notes: Public street; residential buildings are private.

cards.title: The Canopy Corridor
cards.subtitle: East Green Street
cards.notes: Enjoy the tree-lined walk to local favorites like Green Street Restaurant, a staple for student and faculty meetings.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque street known for its ficus tree canopy and local dining institutions.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Street Restaurant is a long-standing Pasadena institution located near the South Campus orbit.
cards.access_notes: Public street; restaurant hours vary.

cards.title: The Cultural Link
cards.subtitle: West Union Street
cards.notes: Stroll this block to reach the Norton Simon Museum and the Pasadena Central Library for research and inspiration.
cards.short_summary: A quiet street connecting major cultural institutions in the Old Pasadena area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Norton Simon Museum is located at the intersection of Colorado Blvd and Orange Grove, accessible via Union St.
cards.access_notes: Public street; museum admission required for entry.

cards.title: The Transit Connection
cards.subtitle: East Del Mar Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the Del Mar Metro station for easy access to the ArtCenter shuttle and local student housing complexes.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street featuring a key Metro A Line station for student commuters.
cards.evidence_claim: The ArtCenter shuttle stops at the Del Mar Metro station to facilitate inter-campus travel.
cards.access_notes: Public street and transit station; shuttle requires ArtCenter ID.

cards.title: The Academic Link
cards.subtitle: East California Boulevard
cards.notes: Walk this corridor to transition between the South Campus buildings and the nearby Caltech campus.
cards.short_summary: A major thoroughfare connecting ArtCenter's South Campus to other academic institutions.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter's 908 Shops are located on South Raymond Avenue between California Blvd and Glenarm St.
cards.source_title: South Campus - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Public street; major artery for local traffic.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and events that define the creative culture of ArtCenter College of Design, from high-speed rubber band races to the iconic orange dot.

cards.title: Formula-E Rubber Band Race
cards.subtitle: High-Speed Elastic Engineering
cards.notes: Watch custom-built, rubber-band-powered vehicles compete in drag races and hill climbs at the Hillside Campus Sculpture Garden.
cards.short_summary: An annual competition where students design and race high-performance vehicles powered entirely by rubber bands.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Formula-E race (where 'E' stands for elastic) features student-designed rubber-band powered cars competing on the Hillside Campus.
cards.source_title: Formula E-lastic - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August at the Hillside Campus Sculpture Garden; open to the public for viewing.

cards.title: The Orange Dot
cards.subtitle: A Century of Visual Identity
cards.notes: Spot the iconic red-orange dot, a symbol of the college since 1930, representing the 'center' of the creative world.
cards.short_summary: The signature graphic symbol of ArtCenter, used nearly continuously for over 90 years to represent the institution.
cards.evidence_claim: The orange dot has been in nearly continuous use as a symbol representing ArtCenter since its inception in 1930.
cards.access_notes: Visible on signage and branding across both the Hillside and South campuses.

cards.title: ArtCenter Car Classic
cards.subtitle: Automotive Design Showcase
cards.notes: Examine world-class automotive design at this annual concours featuring alumni-designed vehicles and rare concepts.
cards.short_summary: A premier annual event celebrating transportation design with a curated field of historic and futuristic vehicles.
cards.evidence_claim: The Car Classic is an annual event held at the Hillside Campus that showcases vehicles designed by ArtCenter alumni and faculty.
cards.source_title: Car Classic - Pasadena - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Sunday in the fall; requires ticket purchase for public entry.

cards.title: Grad Show
cards.subtitle: The Culminating Exhibition
cards.notes: Walk through the massive exhibition of graduating student work, a biannual tradition that draws industry recruiters from around the world.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale exhibition held at the end of each term to showcase the final projects of graduating students.
cards.evidence_claim: Grad Show is a biannual event where graduating students exhibit their work for recruiters, family, and the public.
cards.source_title: Graduation and Grad Show - Pasadena - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Held at the Pasadena Convention Center; the public exhibition day is free to attend.

cards.title: Ellwood Bridge Building
cards.subtitle: Modernist Architectural Icon
cards.notes: Experience the 'bridge' campus, a steel-and-glass structure spanning a 192-foot arroyo, designed by Craig Ellwood.
cards.short_summary: The iconic main building of the Hillside Campus, known for its dramatic modernist design that spans a natural canyon.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillside Campus building is a modernist steel-and-glass bridge structure spanning an arroyo, designed by Craig Ellwood Associates.
cards.source_title: ArtCenter College of Design - LA Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students 24/7; public access is generally limited to event days or by appointment.

cards.title: The Critique Culture
cards.subtitle: Rigorous Creative Feedback
cards.notes: Participate in the intense 'crit' sessions where students present work to faculty and peers for professional-level feedback.
cards.short_summary: A foundational academic tradition at ArtCenter where student work is subjected to rigorous public evaluation.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter's educational model is built on a culture of making, critique, and mentorship.
cards.access_notes: Critiques occur throughout the term in studio spaces; primarily for enrolled students.

cards.title: Dot Launch
cards.subtitle: Incubating Design Ventures
cards.notes: Explore the entrepreneurial side of design through this initiative that helps students turn studio projects into viable businesses.
cards.short_summary: An entrepreneurial program and tradition that supports students in launching design-based startups.
cards.evidence_claim: DOT Launch is ArtCenter's entrepreneurial initiative providing designers with resources to develop ventures.
cards.access_notes: Based at the South Campus; programs and workshops are scheduled throughout the year.

cards.title: Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Gallery Tradition
cards.notes: Wander through the rotating outdoor exhibition of large-scale student and alumni sculptures on the Hillside Campus.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated outdoor space for the display of significant sculptural works by the ArtCenter community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillside Campus features a Sculpture Garden that serves as a venue for events like the Car Classic and Formula-E.
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; public access during scheduled events.

cards.title: Alumni Reunion
cards.subtitle: Global Creative Homecoming
cards.notes: Join hundreds of world-renowned designers as they return to campus to mentor current students and celebrate their legacy.
cards.short_summary: An annual gathering of ArtCenter's influential alumni network, often held in conjunction with the Car Classic.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alumni Reunion is an annual weekend event where hundreds of alumni return to campus to reengage with the college.
cards.source_title: Alumni Reunion - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall; specific events may require registration.

cards.title: 24-Hour Studios
cards.subtitle: The Non-Stop Creative Cycle
cards.notes: Experience the legendary 'always-on' studio culture where students work through the night to perfect their craft.
cards.short_summary: A defining characteristic of ArtCenter life where campus facilities remain open 24/7 to support student projects.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter students have 24-hour access to studio spaces, fostering a rigorous and immersive creative environment.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access is restricted to current students with valid ID cards.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Art Center College of Design, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A curated sequence for new students to navigate ArtCenter's dual-campus layout and creative culture during their first weekend in Pasadena.

cards.title: Kick Off with Campus Connect
cards.subtitle: South Campus Orientation Hub
cards.notes: Start your weekend at the South Campus for the 'Campus Connect' event. Meet your cohort and hear the President's welcome address in the 1111 Building.
cards.short_summary: The official in-person orientation kickoff for new students at the South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: On Sept. 4, the focus shifts to in-person interactions with 'Campus Connect' at 10:00 a.m. on South Campus.
cards.source_title: ArtCenter College of Design to Welcome New Students With Comprehensive Orientation
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for new students; check your Inside ArtCenter portal for specific room assignments.

cards.title: Master the Campus Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Inter-Campus Transit
cards.notes: Board the free shuttle to travel between the Hillside and South campuses. It's the primary way to navigate the 5-mile gap without a car.
cards.short_summary: A complimentary shuttle service connecting the two main campuses and local Metro stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The College also provides a complimentary shuttle service between campuses to help you get to class on time.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid ArtCenter Student ID to board. Operates until 11:30 p.m. on weekdays.

cards.title: Browse the Student Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus Entrance
cards.notes: Visit the gallery at the Hillside entrance to see high-caliber work from current students across all design disciplines.
cards.short_summary: A professional exhibition space showcasing the best student-produced art and design.
cards.evidence_claim: The original Student Gallery, at the entrance to Hillside Campus, for proof of our belief in the power and professionalism of student-produced art.
cards.source_title: Student Gallery - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Open to students during campus hours; typically accessible 12 p.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Lunch at the Hillside Café
cards.subtitle: Main Dining Hall
cards.notes: Grab lunch at the Hillside Café. It's the central social hub for students on the upper campus to refuel between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary cafeteria at the Hillside Campus serving breakfast and lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: The cafeteria at Hillside Campus, operated by Sodexo, serves breakfast, lunch and dinner when school is in session.
cards.source_title: What kind of food options are available at ArtCenter and nearby?
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. during the term.

cards.title: Explore the Fogg Library
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus Resources
cards.notes: Check out the extensive collection of design books, zines, and video games. It's a quiet place to plan your first semester projects.
cards.short_summary: The main library at the Hillside Campus specializing in art and design resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library also features extensive collections of zines and video games; plus subscriptions to dozens of online databases.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.; Friday until 5 p.m. Closed weekends.

cards.title: Afternoon at Sinclaire Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Student Lounge
cards.notes: Relax at this open-air pavilion. It's designed for students to gather and exchange ideas outside of the formal studio environment.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor programming space and student lounge at the Hillside Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sinclaire Pavilion provides students a place to gather, socialize, study and exchange ideas.
cards.source_title: Facilities - ArtCenter Catalog and Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: Open to all students for leisure and study; formal events require scheduling.

cards.title: Gear Up at the Student Store
cards.subtitle: 1111 Building, South Campus
cards.notes: Pick up your required art supplies and ArtCenter apparel. The South Campus location is convenient for those living in downtown Pasadena.
cards.short_summary: The official campus bookstore for art supplies, textbooks, and university merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter - South Campus Store. Street Address. 1111 S Arroyo Parkway. Pasadena, California 91105.
cards.source_title: Hours, Email & Contact Information | ArtCenter Student Store
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; Friday 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

cards.title: Meet Up at Kohl Commons
cards.subtitle: South Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to the 1111 Building's ground floor to socialize. This vibrant space is the main dining and gathering hub for the South Campus.
cards.short_summary: A communal dining and social space at the South Campus 1111 Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Kohl Commons is not only a place to nourish the body, but also a social hub that serves as the South Campus epicenter.
cards.source_title: Terri and Jerry Kohl Commons - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; dining services typically end at 3:00 p.m.

cards.title: Visit the Williamson Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art and Science Exhibitions
cards.notes: Explore the intersection of art and science. This gallery hosts major exhibitions that are integrated into the college curriculum.
cards.short_summary: A premier exhibition space at the Hillside Campus featuring world-class artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4,600-square-foot Alyce de Roulet Williamson Gallery... producing three major exhibitions per year.
cards.source_title: Alyce de Roulet Williamson Gallery | Exhibitions - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12 p.m. to 5 p.m. Reservations recommended.

cards.title: Engage at the Leader Showcase
cards.subtitle: Orientation Finale
cards.notes: End your weekend by viewing the work of Orientation Leaders. It's a great chance to ask upperclassmen for advice on thriving at ArtCenter.
cards.short_summary: An event where new students engage with Orientation Leaders and view their creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Pathways to Success: Leader Showcase' will take place... engage with Orientation Leaders, view their work, and gather advice.
cards.source_title: ArtCenter College of Design to Welcome New Students With Comprehensive Orientation
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the Friday or Saturday of orientation week; check the schedule for locations.
